_meta.title: 拡散モデルを読み込む
MiniMax H3 リファレンスから動画へ

inputs.value:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> Girl, based on <Picture 1>: the same teenage anime girl wearing the headphones, preserving her exact identity, hairstyle, proportions, clothing and overall character design.
<Subject 2> Bicycle, based on <Picture 2>: the exact bicycle shown in the reference, preserving its design, proportions, wheels, frame and recognizable details.
<Subject 3> Grassy hilltop environment: a peaceful open countryside hilltop at golden hour, with soft rolling green grass, scattered tall wild grass and small white flowers, a gentle grassy slope leading up to the crest, a distant town and rolling hills far below, framing trees at the edges, and a warm sunset sky with soft pink and gold clouds. Generate this environment consistently throughout the video and keep its layout stable across all shots.

summary:
[reference generation] The girl rides toward a peaceful hilltop overlook, slows to a stop, leaves her bicycle beside her and takes in the wide landscape below.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout): fully_preserved — preserve the girl's identity, hairstyle, proportions, clothing, headphones and recognizable character design from <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> (appears throughout): fully_preserved — preserve the bicycle's exact design and recognizable physical details from <Picture 2>.

detailed_description:
A warm cinematic slice-of-life anime sequence as the girl reaches a peaceful countryside overlook. The sequence moves naturally from riding to stopping and finally taking in the view, with simple actions and clean cinematic cuts. The hilltop environment stays consistent throughout: the same rolling green grass, wild grass and small white flowers, grassy slope, distant town and warm sunset sky appear in every shot.
[Shot 1] Begin with a wide rear tracking view of <Subject 1> riding <Subject 2> toward the overlook in <Subject 3>. She continues riding forward through the open landscape.
At approximately 00:02.000, make a hard cinematic cut to a side close-up of <Subject 1>'s face. She keeps her head steady as she rides, with only a gentle, natural rise and fall from the bicycle, and lifts her gaze upward toward the bright sky ahead.
At approximately 00:04.000, make a hard cinematic cut to a wide view of the overlook. <Subject 1> rides forward into the open space and gradually slows as she reaches the overlook.
At approximately 00:05.500, make a hard cinematic cut to a slightly elevated side view of <Subject 1>'s hands gripping the handlebars of <Subject 2>, the front wheel visible below, and the grassy ground beneath the bicycle. She squeezes the bicycle brakes, and the handlebar and brake lever are clearly visible as the wheel slows and comes to a complete stop.
At approximately 00:07.500, make a hard cinematic cut to a slightly elevated three-quarter rear view of <Subject 1> as she dismounts, with the bicycle stopped beside her and the grassy hilltop visible around and behind her. She plants her left foot on the ground and swings her right leg off the bicycle, ending up standing on the left side of the bicycle with her body facing the camera side. The bicycle stays upright beside her.
At approximately 00:09.500, make a hard cinematic cut to a medium side view. <Subject 1> stays on the left side of the bicycle, facing the camera side, and walks it a few steps forward toward the edge of the overlook, then gently rests it beside her.
At approximately 00:11.000, make a hard cinematic cut to a close side view of <Subject 1>. She reaches up and removes the headphones, then lets them rest naturally around her neck.
At approximately 00:13.500, make a hard cinematic cut to a medium rear view of <Subject 1> standing beside the bicycle. The enormous landscape opens in front of her as she looks outward over the town.
End with <Subject 1> quietly taking in the view.

overall_soundscape:
Natural countryside ambience. Bicycle tires and chain gradually slowing, subtle brake and wheel sounds, quiet footsteps as she walks the bicycle, gentle wind moving the grass and her clothing, soft breathing after the ride, distant birds and insects. As the bicycle stops, the mechanical sounds fade naturally and the open landscape ambience becomes dominant.
